from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperInfo(BaseModel):
    """Captures one provided paper's title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper being parsed")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (from the collection) that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperInfo]
